text.description_html:
Intermediate Offset Pivot Hinge

Intermediate offset pivot hinge for taller doors that require additional support to keep the middle part of the door in line with the pivot hinges at the top and bottom. Cannot be used with center hung doors. Not intended to be load bearing. For use only with 3/4" offset pivot hinges. Available in Aluminum or Duranodic finish.

Specifications of DC-808 Intermediate Pivot Hinge

  • 3/4" Offset
  • Fully Mortised
  • For use with 1-3/4" Aluminum Storefront Doors
  • Handed

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".

*Sold Individually*
